annotations.title: Google Play's review: where the app stands

description: Where the app's newest production release stands with Google Play's review now (in review, approved and held by managed publishing, not approved, published, a staged rollout's share), the newer build that can go in its place, Google's decisions before, the requests waiting for a person, the next steps with the tool for each, and managed publishing as far as Ploa can tell. Google's API can't read or change managed publishing, or publish a release it holds: Ploa knows it's on once Google has held an approved release, and turning it on or off and publishing are the person's step in Play Console › Publishing overview (the link is in the answer; say plainly that Ploa can't do it). Read-only.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask Google Play now (it has a daily limit per app; Ploa reads a few times a day by itself).
